chat.airdropText: See the hourly period, the conditions and your verified entitlements on the rewards screen. Demo games do not create entitlements.

errors.request: The chat request could not be completed.

wallet.leadConnected: The connection was made through your own wallet.
wallet.leadConnect: Your assets stay under your control. Connecting does not start a transaction or a transfer.
wallet.copyFailed: The address could not be copied.

wallet.noneTitle: No wallet found in this browser

wallet.noneDemo: You can try the local demo without connecting a wallet.

game.noticeLocal: This game runs in your browser. DEMO is a trial credit with no value; it does not earn SOL or tokens. Local randomness is used; there is no VRF proof.
game.noticeRemote: The round is decided on the server the moment the bet is accepted; your browser only displays it. Once the server seed is revealed, you can recompute the round yourself on the <link>verification page</link>. DEMO has no value; it does not earn SOL or tokens. This is not a certified RNG.
game.historyEmptyTitle: Your first round will appear here.
game.historyEmptyText: When you play the demo, you can follow the amount and the result together.
game.rulesAccess: Real play access requires the contract and network configuration to be verified separately.
